test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) for higher education

(B) many students

(C) prefer to go abroad

(D) these days
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **BACD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Many students," which is correctly indicated by **part (B).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "for higher education" **(AC)** adds the purpose of the action, indicated by (A).
 
• **The next part,** "prefer to go abroad," continues the logical sequence, indicating the action the students prefer.
 
• **Ending with **"these days" (D) completes the sentence by providing a time frame for the action.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BACD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (ABCD):** This option starts with "for higher education many students these days prefer to go abroad," which does not follow a logical sequence as the subject is not introduced first.
 
• **Option 2 (BDAC):** This option starts with "many students these days for higher education prefer to go abroad," which creates an incomplete and awkward sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3 (BADC):** This option starts with "many students for higher education these days prefer to go abroad," which disrupts the flow of the sentence.
